title: Arithmetic Reasoning Content Index
description: Index all AFOQT Arithmetic Reasoning JSON files and expose subtopics/difficulty structure for the game engine and Copilot.

mappedGameSubtopics.description: Straightforward word problems involving basic operations and rate = work/time style reasoning.
Setting up and solving ratio and proportion equations inside word problems (mixtures, scaling, map reading, etc.).
Percent increase/decrease, simple interest-style problems, and percent-of/base/amount translation in word form.
Word problems requiring conversions between fractions, decimals, and mixed numbers; operations in context.
Time, rate, and work problems including combined work, travel time, and productivity style scenarios.
Simple discrete probability, equally likely outcomes, and basic compound events framed as word problems.
Using variables and simple linear equations to solve unknowns in word problems (age, mixtures, motion, etc.).
Average/mean word problems, weighted averages, and solving for missing value given total and count.

logicForCopilot: Scan the Arithmetic Reasoning content directory (or zip) for all JSON files except shared schema/metadata files.
Infer `subtopicId` and `difficulty` from the filename; normalize difficulty to one of: `beginner`, `advanced`, `expert`.
Load each file and append all `questions[]` into an in-memory registry keyed as `questions['arithmetic_reasoning'][subtopicId][difficulty]`.
Use `subjects[].mappedGameSubtopics` to validate that `subtopicId` is recognized and mark whether it is an official AFOQT topic.
Use this registry for study mode, drill mode, and AFOQT-style practice tests for Arithmetic Reasoning.
